aarti.tek: Victory to the Lord of Jānakī;
victory to Śrī Rāma, Lord of the Raghus.
With both hands joined I pray:
aarti.pad1: You are our Lord of the Raghus,
our life, our father and mother;
you alone are the companion of the good,
the giver of devotion and liberation.
aarti.pad2: Cut away the round of the eighty-four lakh births
and wipe out the terror of Yama.
Lord, keep me night and day
aarti.pad3: Śrī Rāma, Bharata and Lakṣmaṇa are there,
and with them their brother Śatrughna;
aarti.pad4: Mother Kausalyā performs the āratī with a golden platter.
aarti.pad5: A lovely crown on his head, bow and arrow in his hands,
gives himself to him every moment.
